hotspots.name: your escape pod
hotspots.look: Your escape pod, lying in the junk like a very expensive mistake. It got you here, and that is the whole review.

hotspots.name: small object
hotspots.look: A small object lies on the ground. It is not yours, it is not important, and you are already planning to remember where it is.

hotspots.name: red barrel
hotspots.look: A big red drum, lying on its side and rusting with the dignity of something that was once in charge of something.

hotspots.name: control stick
hotspots.look: A control stick on a broken pedestal. Whatever it controlled has stopped answering.

hotspots.name: bent pipe
hotspots.look: A pipe, bent into an arch by some event nobody mentions.

hotspots.name: way east
hotspots.look: A gap in the junk to the east, leading towards a large tube.

hotspots.name: way south
hotspots.look: A path south, through more junk.

hotspots.name: arched doorways
hotspots.look: Three arched doorways into a long, round tube. The middle one is open, and it breathes slightly.

hotspots.name: ladder
hotspots.look: A light ladder, leaning on a pile of nothing in particular, waiting for someone to have a reason.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back to the crash site.

hotspots.name: hole in the floor
hotspots.look: A square hole in the floor with a ladder inside. Cold air comes up. So do small, interested sounds.

hotspots.name: hanging wires
hotspots.look: Wires hang from the ceiling of the tube, some of them still carrying current and all of them still carrying opinions.

hotspots.name: tube entrance
hotspots.look: Back out of the tube.

hotspots.name: far end
hotspots.look: The far end of the tube.

hotspots.name: broken eye
hotspots.look: The robot's eye: a huge red lens, cracked in the middle. Behind the crack there is room for a person with poor judgement.

hotspots.name: giant robot head
hotspots.look: A giant robot head with a green diamond on its forehead. It has been looking at the same piece of ceiling for years.

hotspots.name: green panel
hotspots.look: A green panel, bent out of its frame. It looks like a door that has given up its job.

hotspots.name: chasm
hotspots.look: A chasm lies at the edge of the platform. It does not look deep. It looks patient.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back along the tube.

hotspots.name: warp motivator
hotspots.look: A white drum with a dark hole in the end: a warp motivator, large, expensive, and lying in the rubble like a cooking pot. Far too heavy for hands.

hotspots.name: shuttle
hotspots.look: A small shuttle lying in the junk, battered into a shape it was never designed for. It looks as if it still hopes.

hotspots.name: open panel
hotspots.look: An open maintenance panel in the shuttle. Inside there is a motivator-sized hole, and nothing to fill it.

hotspots.name: ladder down
hotspots.look: The ladder down to the robot's platform.

hotspots.name: far platform
hotspots.look: The end of the rail platform. There is a chute here, and a railing that does not inspire trust.

hotspots.name: warp motivator
hotspots.look: A white drum with a dark hole in the end: a warp motivator, large, expensive, and lying in the rubble like a cooking pot.

hotspots.name: shuttle
hotspots.look: A small shuttle lying in the junk, battered into a shape it was never designed for. A ladder now leans against its side.

hotspots.name: ladder
hotspots.look: The ladder, leaning on the shuttle. Its rungs are thin, but so are your options.

hotspots.name: top hatch
hotspots.look: A small hatch on top of the shuttle, with a latch and a long history of being ignored.

hotspots.name: power panel
hotspots.look: The power panel: a reactor-shaped hole and a wire-shaped hole.

hotspots.name: ladder down
hotspots.look: The ladder down to the robot's platform.

hotspots.name: far platform
hotspots.look: The end of the rail platform.

hotspots.name: wrecked fighter wheel
hotspots.look: A big round wheel from some old fighter, with six spokes. It looks like it could have been a gun's very expensive eye.

hotspots.name: rocket tube
hotspots.look: A white and red rocket tube, standing in the junk like an enormous pen that has run out of ink.

hotspots.name: ship hull
hotspots.look: Part of a ship's hull. The letters say JUP. Whatever they spelled has been lost.

hotspots.name: pink box
hotspots.look: A pink box with a door that does not close. It contains the same thing everything here contains: past.

hotspots.name: way north
hotspots.look: Back to the crash site.

hotspots.name: way east
hotspots.look: The junk continues east, towards a tall tower.

hotspots.name: lift tower
hotspots.look: A tall tower with a lift platform hanging from a chain. A little bucket hangs at the top, collecting scrap and carrying it away to somewhere worse.

hotspots.name: pink slab
hotspots.look: A pink slab leaning against a heap. It has the shape of a staircase for someone much, much bigger.

hotspots.name: wrecked pod
hotspots.look: A big wrecked pod, half buried. It wears a number and some scorch marks.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back through the junk field.

hotspots.name: conveyor belt
hotspots.look: A moving belt, carrying everything towards a shredder at its end. The belt does not care what.

hotspots.name: shredder
hotspots.look: A shredder: a red box with steel teeth in a tidy row. It is patient, like the sea.

hotspots.name: cyan rail
hotspots.look: A glowing rail runs overhead. Within reach, if you can jump.

hotspots.name: overhead pipes
hotspots.look: Pipes and conduits, painted in the colours that someone chose in a hurry.

hotspots.name: blue chute
hotspots.look: A blue chute leads down into the dark. A sign says ONE WAY, and nobody has painted the other way.

hotspots.name: west along the rail
hotspots.look: The rail continues west.

hotspots.name: east along the rail
hotspots.look: The rail continues east.

hotspots.name: control room
hotspots.look: Through the glass: a control room, teal and spotless. A droid sits at the console, reading the same line again and again.

hotspots.name: west along the rail
hotspots.look: The rail continues west.

hotspots.name: east along the rail
hotspots.look: Back along the rail.

hotspots.name: magenta tower
hotspots.look: A tall magenta tower with a window of oval slots, standing in the middle of everything with great self-importance.

hotspots.name: grabber
hotspots.look: A rail grabber: a little cab, a rod and a claw. Whoever left it went home early and left the keys in.

hotspots.name: east along the rail
hotspots.look: Back along the rail.

hotspots.name: reactor
hotspots.look: A warp-core reactor, sitting in a hole in the rock with a red wire coming down to it like a leash. It hums in a tone that suggests it has plans.

hotspots.name: hole
hotspots.look: A hole in the floor, big enough for the reactor and several regrets.

hotspots.name: red wire
hotspots.look: A red wire runs down from the ceiling into the hole. Somebody wanted this reactor to stay where it was.

hotspots.name: red eyes
hotspots.look: In the corners of the room, pairs of small red eyes keep a polite distance, and keep it carefully.

hotspots.name: ladder
hotspots.look: A ladder up to the tube entrance.

hotspots.name: pilot's seat
hotspots.look: The pilot's seat. It has the shape of a person who gave up long ago. The cushion is lumpy in a way that suggests savings.

hotspots.name: ship's computer
hotspots.look: A computer that thinks about it for a while, then says maybe.

hotspots.name: viewport
hotspots.look: Through the round window: the robot's platform, and everything else in the world, still lying where it fell.

hotspots.name: launch lever
hotspots.look: The launch lever. It does nothing until the computer is ready, and the computer is never ready on the first try.

hotspots.name: exit hatch
hotspots.look: The hatch back out onto the shuttle's roof.
